description: Shared test cases for ExtractionPathSafety.relativePath, consumed by both android/app/src/test/java/org/tzap/zmanager/mobile/ArchiveExtractionTest.kt and ios/ZManagerMobile/ZManagerMobileTests/ZManagerMobileTests.swift. Each case constructs a fresh temp root per run; 'root' below is a placeholder for that temp directory. See Track 4 in docs/mobile-code-health-remediation-plan.md.

descoped.name: empty_component
descoped.reason: Both java.nio.file.Path and Foundation's URL collapse consecutive separators before ExtractionPathSafety ever sees the string, on both platforms, confirmed by direct probing of both implementations. Not reachable via any real File/URL construction path a caller in this codebase actually uses. The explicit isEmpty check exists on both platforms now as defense-in-depth, but no fixture case can demonstrate divergence.

descoped.name: dot_component
descoped.reason: Same normalization as empty_component; both platforms collapse './' before the check runs.

descoped.name: trailing_separator
descoped.reason: Same normalization as empty_component; both platforms strip a trailing separator before the check runs.

descoped.name: case_variant_root_prefix
descoped.reason: Filesystem case-sensitivity is environment-dependent (case-insensitive by default on macOS/iOS Simulator, case-sensitive on Linux CI runners), so a fixture case here would be non-portable rather than a genuine cross-platform behavioral check.
